## Build it

- Fine-tune a 0.5B–3B model with QLoRA on 1,000 examples of a narrow task and compare it with the base model on 50 held-out cases.
- Train a small model with GRPO on GSM8K using exact-match rewards; plot reward, response length, and accuracy.
- Collect 300 chosen/rejected pairs and run DPO on top of your fine-tuned model.
